closes: OVERALL_PLAN.md completion criterion 1: every required model family must carry an exact-checkpoint, license, exposure, runtime and native-task disposition. This record supplies the missing native-task axis only.
disposition_scope: Native-task disposition only. This record adds no capability, opens no checkpoint, deserializes nothing, and bypasses no license gate. The base registry under config/models/ is unchanged.

model_dispositions.reason: config/evaluation/family_native_tournament.toml lists sei under required_family_disposition with required_tasks including sequence_native_regulatory, but that task has no TaskSpec, no capability roster and no task_fit key anywhere. No native-task disposition can be earned or refused until the task is registered.

reason_1_task_not_registered.statement: config/evaluation/family_native_tournament.toml holds [task.sequence_native_regulatory] at status = planned_registration and lists it under task_ids_to_register, not under active_task_ids. config/tasks/ contains eight TaskSpecs (bulk_state_transfer, cell_state_mapping, gene_perturbation_response, perturbation_transfer, rna_conditioned_atac, typed_evidence_graph, unified_model, variant_to_regulation) and none of them is sequence_native_regulatory. The string does not appear as a task_fit key in any bundle under config/artifacts/models/.

artifacts.note: No task_id key. Binds evaluator_contract = config/evaluation/sequence_task_native_five_seed_rectangular_evaluator_20260825.json, whose task_id is rna_conditioned_atac.

reason_2_sequence_artifacts_are_bound_to.statement: The three artifacts that look like the sequence lane are bound to rna_conditioned_atac, not to sequence_native_regulatory. sequence_terminal_admission.json and sequence_task_native_five_seed_rectangular_evaluator_20260825.json each carry task_id = "rna_conditioned_atac" literally. sequence_regulatory_full_rectangle_completion_20260825.json carries no task_id field of its own and reaches the same lane through its evaluator_contract, which is the rna_conditioned_atac-bound evaluator. Their model rosters are bpnet, chrombpnet, scbasset and the sequence CNN/transformer controls; none of the ten model_ids in this record appears in them. Mislabelling these artifacts as the sequence-native lane has already cost this campaign time on 2026-08-25 and is recorded here so it is not repeated.

root_cause.reason_3_registry_cannot_name_the_task: Every one of the ten model_ids declares supported_tasks = ["variant_to_regulation"] in the base registry. It cannot declare sequence_native_regulatory because that id is not a registered task, so the tournament's required_family_disposition and the registry's supported_tasks disagree by construction until the TaskSpec is registered.

sequence_lane_runtime_constraint.cluster_fact: L40S nodes ne1dg6-* run driver 550.107.02 with CUDA 12.4; B6K nodes ne1dg7-* run driver 590.48.01 with CUDA 13.1. Job 21106572 verified that torch 2.13.0+cu130 cannot initialise on L40S (no_cuda_device_visible) and job 21106573 verified that torch 2.6.0+cu124 cannot run on B6K (no_matching_sass). torch 2.8.0+cu128 is the only runtime in the tree that executes on both pools, and even there the L40S-versus-B6K architecture effect was adjudicated materially_different.
sequence_lane_runtime_constraint.statement: The task-native sequence rectangle cannot move to the newly admitted B6K GPUs. BPNet declares TensorFlow 2.4.1 upstream and runs under a tensorflow_2.8.2_gpu compatibility runtime with device_class NVIDIA_L40S_sm89 and environment_status PASSED_COMPATIBILITY_NOT_NATIVE_VERSION_PARITY. ChromBPNet declares TensorFlow 2.8.0 with environment_status UNRESOLVED_L40S_COMPATIBILITY_PROBE_REQUIRED. TensorFlow 2.8.x cannot target sm_120, so neither model can execute on the B6K pool.
